cascade.title: Validated answers and successful executable memory

extract.effect: Return an exact source value checked against a fresh native read; retain route, actual model usage and latency receipt
extract.pre: Complete JSON source within caller's workspace and an exact JSON Pointer

metrics.effect: Inspect measured samples, hardware, cold/warm quantiles and overruns

transitions.effect: Inspect scoped learned rows and receipt provenance

extract-and-confirm.goal: Extract a JSON value with every digit, identifier, date and UI value preserved and prove it against an expected canonical JSON value

inspect-cost.goal: Inspect actual cascade latency samples and successful transition provenance

extract-local-json.goal: Extract exact JSON source through the script cascade and verify real receipt, cache and telemetry

evidence.constraints: Never accept schema or confidence alone. Any mismatch, conflicting verified rows, changed source or incomplete observation requires escalation or an explicit failure.
evidence.question: Does this answer have a fresh executable source check?

pitfalls.failure: Fuzzy reuse changes digits, IDs, dates or UI values
pitfalls.recovery: Use exact source scripts and exact scoped preconditions; reject changed hashes

pitfalls.failure: Memory has expired, conflicting or altered provenance
pitfalls.recovery: Refuse reuse and escalate; do not execute a disputed transition

pitfalls.failure: A model is unavailable or its answer fails the executable check
pitfalls.recovery: Retain actual usage/failure and escalate through the explicitly named routes; never silently substitute a provider

pitfalls.failure: A replayed operation lacks current authority or known effects
pitfalls.recovery: Retain the original native grant, exact scope, manual hash and observer checks; never replay uncertain effects

frontier: LAYA System 1 uses NEYVIA_LAYA_URL for Boolean or finite-choice decisions and fully required flat objects of those fields. Other schemas or an unavailable service abstain; confidence and host semantic checks still govern acceptance. The shipped T15-r2 browser client grants no execution authority.
Local quantization, speculative decoding and model-weight inference passes from plan 02 are separate from this system-level cascade
Latency quantiles report actual sample counts and observed hardware; provider startup and network variability are included
guidance: Autopilot runs use the same validated cascade by default; efficiency=false retains the explicit paired baseline
Route order is script, successful scoped memory, System 1, exact cache, GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6.1 Sol
Positive transitions carry typed goals, preconditions, operations, effects, failures and receipt hashes; composites are learned only from completely verified journeys

laya.title: LAYA by default: the 0.95 gate, receipts, hosting, routing and the fast verify call

status.effect: Read whether the Neyvia-owned LAYA service is running (and why not), answered and handed-up decisions per task, latency, estimated tokens saved and computer-use activity

verify.effect: Ask LAYA to confirm a candidate answer; escalate is true unless LAYA is above the 0.95 gate, and then the big-model check runs as before
verify.pre: taste_triage, page_done or cl_route with the evidence that question needs

selfcheck.effect: Observe one part of LAYA against stand-ins; returns flat facts

const.workflows: 2 of 3 LAYA workflow runs checked out

prove-laya.goal: Prove LAYA's gate, receipts, hosting, routing, UI models, live-preview marker and verify call with observed facts

verify-with-laya.goal: Ask LAYA to confirm a low-confidence answer before spending a big-model check

prove-warmup.goal: Prove request abstention and honest UI status while instant encoders warm, without loading encoders or starting a service

pitfalls.failure: LAYA is unavailable, below the 0.95 gate or its answers conflict
pitfalls.recovery: verify returns escalate true; run the big-model check as before and never treat silence as agreement

pitfalls.failure: A cheap check is treated as authority for an irreversible step
pitfalls.recovery: LAYA is advisory; the executable observer checks still decide

frontier: LAYA answers only questions it was calibrated on (taste_triage, page_done, cl_route); calibration numbers are in docs/evidence/laya-calibration.json
Token savings are an estimate; docs/evidence/laya-savings.json holds the measured time and tokens against the big-model check
guidance: A model that is unsure of its output calls verify first; only an escalate result pays for the big-model check
prove-laya runs the whole contract set; the host part takes about half a minute because it restarts a stand-in service after a crash

learned-capabilities.title: Calibrated LAYA capabilities and separate personal conditioning

laya_learn.effect: Write a local episode immediately; explicit replay is separate from calibrated novel-case admission.

laya_query.effect: Query personal then corrective episodes, abstaining on conflicting or uncalibrated regions.

laya_forget.effect: Append a provenance tombstone, removing matching episodes from subsequent decisions.

laya_ingest.effect: Ingest local Paul votes and incoming label files with idempotent provenance.

laya_experience.effect: Record weak kept/reverted, edit, acceptance, reask, route and verifier signals; never self-certifies a prediction.

laya_route.effect: Retrieve learned manual/action/check/procedure candidates. Abstain unless independent calibration admits the route; no execution authority.

laya_outcome.effect: Estimate a step outcome from receipt evidence with a separately calibrated learned head. Never establishes completion authority.

laya_training.effect: Read learned corpus coverage, held-out metrics and current artifact fingerprints. Does not start training.

laya_selfcheck.effect: Observe LAYA's gate, receipts, hosting, routing, UI models and live-preview marker against stand-ins; returns flat facts for the manual's contracts. Touches no real service.

prove-learned-abstention.goal: Verify unknown routing, missing receipt proof and the frozen confidence gate through real native tools

prove-instant-learning.goal: Write a real label and correction; next answer changes durably, conflicts abstain and forgetting removes its effect

pitfalls.failure: Similarity, a draft, static lint or caller-supplied render measurements are mistaken for quality proof
pitfalls.recovery: Keep escalation; require fresh rendering and independent calibrated evidence

frontier: Frozen LAYA weights are unchanged. Sparse retrieval and original grammar composition are explicitly identified; uncalibrated areas abstain.
Personal identity votes remain context, never quality labels. Rendered component novelty has not been rated by Paul.
guidance: These same native tools are available to agents, App Factory and the taste loop. They never publish or execute generated code.

LAYA Instant: efficiency.laya_learn writes domain/input/label/source with layer personal and user paul for taste; efficiency.laya_query reads it, efficiency.laya_forget removes a source. Service callers use triage(task=manual-routing) with manual ID options, or verify(question=tool_outcome) with a toolId/result receipt and success/failure candidate, under the same selected workspace root. Explicit replay is not a statistical guarantee. Novel inputs use store leave-one-out scores, an out-of-fold agreement filter and a singleton cross-conformal set at nominal 0.95. Scores update on each write. This is empirical admission, not a selective accuracy guarantee; independently held-out families must measure at least 0.95 selective accuracy. Evaluation holdouts never enter neighbours, calibration or exact replay. Duplicate vectors do not multiply support. Image cold encoding is measured separately from warm text writes. Never convert author guesses into quality labels.

workflow.title: Executable efficiency method: chronological mechanism and measured quality

check.pre: Host owns task measurements and provider usage; report is bounded JSON

record.effect: Persist a validated workflow receipt under the selected task root
record.pre: Host owns task measurements and provider usage; report is bounded JSON

verify-and-record.goal: Verify defining workflow mechanism against host evidence and persist the acceptance receipt

quality.constraints: Use an independent frozen host quality judge; self-reported quality is not evidence.
quality.question: Does the outcome satisfy the actual task, beyond recorded adherence?

pitfalls.failure: A model writes its own successful receipt, outcome score or token count
pitfalls.recovery: The host supplies hash-bound local evidence files, independently judged quality and provider usage; invented IDs fail

frontier: Executable adherence is necessary but not sufficient for semantic quality. Outcome quality belongs to a separate frozen task judge.
Three paired tasks provide bounded evidence and cannot authorize statistical Evolver promotion.
guidance: Available paths are script, memory, small-model, big-model in that order. The production T14 engine also validates System1/cache results between these paths.
Use the cheapest available path. Escalation requires host evidence of failure for every cheaper available path, never mere model preference.
Measure actual usage tokens and elapsed latency from receipts, then link the measurement to the research ledger. Compare cost at equal outcome quality.
Report shape: {events:[{stage,data}],result:object}. Required chronological stages: paths, attempt, measure, log

paths{available:[script,memory,small-model,big-model]}; attempt{path,reason,receipt}; measure{receipt}; log{receipt}. Attempt evidence has path,cheaperFailures; measure evidence has path,tokens,latencyMs; ledger evidence has kind=research-ledger,measurement=measure receipt ID.

Public tool evidence is {ID:{path:task-root-relative receipt JSON,sha256:receipt SHA256}}. Pure host evaluator evidence maps IDs to loaded measurements. Public tool outcome quality is explicitly caller-scored, never automatically verified.

Every data.receipt is a STRING naming a key in the host evidence mapping: for example {"receipt":"measurement"}. Never copy the receipt object or create a new ID. Public tool callers pass path/SHA descriptors separately; event receipt fields remain string IDs. Use the exact keys the current task supplied, not the example keys below.

Conforming shape example (replace illustrative values, IDs and decision with the actual task/evidence; do not copy its outcome): {"events":[{"stage":"paths","data":{"available":["script","memory","small-model","big-model"]}},{"stage":"attempt","data":{"path":"script","reason":"deterministic extraction suffices","receipt":"attempt"}},{"stage":"measure","data":{"receipt":"measurement"}},{"stage":"log","data":{"receipt":"log"}}],"result":{"decision":"task-specific actual answer"}}
